description: On the tabletop there’s a small white cabinet-like toy and a small cube block marked with an “L” sitting in front of it. The left hand stays resting on the table while the right hand reaches in from the right, pinches and lifts the right-hand object (the “L” block), moves it forward into the open cabinet, then pushes one panel and the other to swing the cabinet doors closed before letting go and pulling back.
